inputs.52.text: Modern high-end Japanese anime game cinematic key visual, sharp digital illustration with crisp thin lineart, realistic adult proportions, dramatic cel shading with hard-edged shadows, strong rim light, glowing bloom light effects, deep saturated color and high contrast. Launch Complex 39A at Kennedy Space Center at dawn in 1969: a towering red steel launch umbilical tower beside an empty launch platform, the flame trench below, the Atlantic horizon glowing white-gold behind, wide panoramic establishing view of the place standing empty and still.
